title: Security & Authentication
description: Every way to prove who you are and lock down what you can do: password hashing & sessions, JWT, OAuth2/OIDC (auth-code + PKCE, client-credentials, device), SAML & enterprise SSO, API keys & mTLS, MFA (TOTP) & passwordless (WebAuthn/passkeys), plus authorization (RBAC/ABAC/ReBAC) and the OWASP Top 10 (XSS, SQLi, CSRF, SSRF, IDOR) — built and attacked hands-on, then hardened.
